name: UpCity
author: Serponge
description: Fly through the green orb at 25% while not touching it after becoming ship and then straightfly between the two spikes and saws. After that hold in the ceiling until you hit the 3x speed portal and then fly in the middle avoiding other speed portals at 26%. Then at 30%, you have to start navigating through the level's gameplay as the ship. Move to the ceiling at 35% after passing through all of the levels gameplay. Briefly fall down from the ceiling at 56% to land on the block in front of the cube portal and then move back up to the ceiling until 59% where you can fall to the floor. Stay on the floor until the end from there.
